unknown: SWE-Bench Pro (Scale, public V2): no Qwen row among the 11 rows of the Scale leaderboard read on 2026-10-03; the page shows no update date
Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index: no row for this model on Artificial Analysis's coding-agent leaderboard (read 2026-10-03), which lists Qwen3.8 Max only
METR 50% time horizon: METR's page (last updated 2026-05-08) mentions only 'Qwen models' (added 2025-06-27) and its chart values are not in the page text, so a Qwen3.x entry is not ruled out
retires: 2026-10-10 is QwenCloud's notice for the hosted endpoint only; the open weights remain on Hugging Face, and no replacement is named on the page
max_output: 65,536 is the hosted endpoint's limit on QwenCloud's page (64k in its model table); the open weights state none
cached_input: no cache rate on the QwenCloud page for this model
benchmark rows: the model card carries its benchmark tables as images and its text gives no scores, so the vendor figures rest on a secondary article that attributes them to the Qwen team
system_card: none; the maker may not publish one
access: Amazon Bedrock lists the model (Amazon's documentation) and OpenRouter lists it (read 2026-10-03); Novita rested on an earlier reading that was not re-checked, so it is left out
class: QwenCloud's model table now files qwen3-coder-next under Legacy and recommends qwen3.7-plus and qwen3.8-max for coding tools; no newer Coder model was found
